intended_object: The map sending a closed subgroup H of a topological group G to its conjugacy class {gHg⁻¹ : g ∈ G} among closed subgroups. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The definition is the quotient map `Quotient.mk _ H` into `ClosedSubgroupConjClasses G`. That type is the orbit quotient of the `ConjAct G` action on `ClosedSubgroup G`. The action is conjugation by g, through the inner automorphism `ContinuousAut.conj g`, and the module's lemma `ConjAct.smul_closedSubgroup_toSubgroup` shows it agrees with Mathlib's pointwise conjugation of subgroups. So two closed subgroups have the same class exactly when they are conjugate (this is `mk_eq_mk_iff`), and this map is the standard class map.

The only topological hypothesis is `SeparatelyContinuousMul G`. It is there so that conjugation is a homeomorphism and therefore sends closed subgroups to closed subgroups. That is close to the minimum the construction needs, so the setting is not too narrow; it is more general than "topological group".

Mathlib has `ConjClasses.mk` for conjugacy classes of elements, and it lets `ConjAct` act on `Subgroup` pointwise. It has no closed-subgroup version of this quotient map, so there is no Mathlib counterpart to cite.
